question: What recitation count enables the completion of the full bathing rite?
premises: The aghora mantra is to be recited.
The recitation count specified is three hundred.
The complete bathing rite must be brought to completion.
inference: After chanting the aghora mantra three hundred times, one should complete the full bathing.
plain_english: Having chanted the aghora mantra three hundred times, one should carry out the complete bathing.
